session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Broad Bear Channel'. LH double top at the 4600 open high, bear trend through the falling wedge into the 4554 green dotted floor, a bull wedge rally to the 4590 wedge top and triangle top, a decline back to the lower low (LL MTR) with the wedge at EMA and ii bounce, then the iii leg sell-off to 4525 testing the Dec 20 low dotted line into the close.
